author: Unreal Engine
description:
Ever wonder who’s driving those massive, immersive screens at live concerts and theater? It’s real-time teams using Unreal Engine to blur the lines between reality and digital art.

Jonathan Masterson of Silent Partners Studio joins us to break down how they brought the urban world of La Haine to life on stage and why "curiosity" is the #1 skill you need to get hired.

Ready to build the future of live entertainment?: https://youtu.be/-aFJC1U-EKM
title: POV: You’re the one behind the visuals at a sold-out show. 🏟️✨
